Lumi Privacy Policy

Effective date: June 29, 2026
Last updated: July 28, 2026
App name: Lumi
Package name: com.huangder.lumibooks
Developer: huangder
Contact: huangder0104@126.com

1. Core principles
Lumi is an open-source, local-first e-book reader. Your library, reading progress, bookmarks, notes and most settings stay on your device by default. Network requests happen only when you configure or enable features such as WebDAV sync, MinerU cloud parsing, third-party TTS, update/policy checks, or external links.

2. Permissions
Storage/media permissions read the EPUB, TXT, PDF, cover or image files you choose. Legacy write storage may save files or write back authorized TXT files on Android 9 and below. INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE are used for update/policy checks, WebDAV, MinerU, third-party TTS and external links. WRITE_SETTINGS is used only when you enable custom screen timeout. Foreground service and notification permissions are used for TTS playback and parsing/sync progress. Lumi does not request location, camera, microphone, contacts, phone state, SMS or calendar permissions.

3. Data stored locally
Book files, reading progress, bookmarks, notes and selected text, reading time, preferences, file/folder authorization URIs, edited TXT content, MinerU settings, WebDAV settings, third-party TTS settings and local TTS audio cache may be stored locally. MinerU tokens, WebDAV passwords and third-party TTS API keys are encrypted with Android Keystore and excluded from system backup/device transfer.

4. Optional data transmission
WebDAV sync uploads/downloads book files, file manifests, reading progress, bookmarks, notes and selected text to the server you configure. MinerU cloud parsing sends your selected PDF, parsing parameters, task identifiers and, for precise parsing, your personal token to OpenDataLab/MinerU. Third-party TTS sends the current text segment, model/voice, style instructions and required credentials to the service you choose, such as OpenAI TTS, Xiaomi MiMo or a compatible endpoint. External links are opened only when you tap them.

5. What Lumi does not do
Lumi does not collect names, phone numbers, precise location, contacts or device identifiers for tracking. It does not include analytics, ads, profiling, third-party push or crash-reporting SDKs. It does not provide a Lumi account system or a developer-operated cloud library.

6. Third-party services
MinerU/OpenDataLab, your WebDAV provider or self-hosted server, OpenAI, Xiaomi MiMo and custom TTS services operate independently from Lumi. Their availability, pricing, retention, deletion and compliance rules are governed by their own terms and privacy policies.

1. Acceptance
By downloading, installing, opening or using Lumi, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, stop using the app.

2. App features
Lumi is an open-source, local-first e-book reader for EPUB, TXT and PDF. It supports local library management, reading progress, bookmarks, notes, reading statistics, system TTS, TXT editing, file/folder authorization, optional MinerU cloud PDF parsing, optional WebDAV sync, and optional third-party TTS such as OpenAI TTS, Xiaomi MiMo or compatible endpoints. Lumi does not provide a Lumi account or a developer-operated cloud library. WebDAV, MinerU and third-party TTS require your active configuration or confirmation.

3. Your responsibilities
You must ensure that books and text you read, import, edit, parse, speak or sync do not infringe rights or laws. Only upload, sync or send files and text you are allowed to process. Do not transmit DRM-protected content, sensitive personal information of others, trade secrets or unlawful content. You are responsible for protecting WebDAV passwords, MinerU tokens and third-party TTS API keys, and for complying with each provider terms, privacy policy, fees and limits. Back up important TXT files before saving edits.

4. Disclaimers
Lumi is provided as is. Compatibility with all files, devices, Android versions and third-party APIs is not guaranteed. You are responsible for losses caused by device failure, mistakes, revoked permissions, corrupted files, sync conflicts, third-party outages, fees or policy changes. WebDAV, MinerU and third-party TTS are operated by third parties or your own environment; Lumi does not guarantee availability, integrity, retention, deletion, parsing or speech quality. TXT editing changes authorized files, so keep backups.

5. Privacy
Reading data stays local by default. Network requests occur only when you configure or enable WebDAV, MinerU, third-party TTS, update checks or external links. See the Privacy Policy for details.

6. Changes and termination
These terms may be updated for feature, legal or service changes. You may stop using and uninstall the app at any time. Uninstalling removes app-private data, but not original book files, WebDAV copies or data already processed by third-party services.
